text: {"outsider_clarity":4,"professional_relevance":4,"specificity":4,"novel_insight":3,"practical_usefulness":4,"emotional_tension":3,"conversation_potential":4,"shareability":3,"voice_authenticity":3,"gaps":["Repeated qualifications and restatements dilute the central point; consolidate the evidence boundaries and shorten the ending.","The familiar distinction between fast output and finished work is useful but offers limited fresh insight beyond the proposed measurement.","The explanatory middle feels more like a research briefing than the supplied conversational, bold voice."],"rationale":"The post offers grounded, appropriately bounded evidence and a useful approval-time comparison, but repetition, modest novelty and a formal middle limit its distinctiveness and impact."}
